structural_alignment.rule: All shelf/floor holes and passages are derived from the same rear-edge and centerline datums; never dimension mating features independently from opposite side edges.

upright_locking_interface.main_shelf_captive_thread: 3/8-16 T-nut from underside or equivalent metal-backed captive nut
upright_locking_interface.backbox_fastener: wing screw, hand knob bolt, or captive socket bolt accessible from inside backbox
upright_locking_interface.note: The backbox floor is clamped down onto the rear shelf. Hinge pivots provide folding motion; the shelf and locking bolts carry/stabilize the upright assembly.

primary_fold_harness.final_interface: tool-removable split compression cable-entry/gland plate with elastomer inserts; not an open brush-only hole

display_mount_system.architecture: closed-backbox internal adjustable aluminium T-slot/service subframe with independent upper backglass and lower DMD carriages
display_mount_system.structural_load_path: display subframe ties into dedicated top/bottom crossmembers and side/perimeter structure; rear service door is not a primary monitor load path

rear_vertical_rails.preferred_profile: 20x40 mm T-slot aluminium extrusion or equivalent slotted structural rail
rear_vertical_rails.mounting: bolted to dedicated structural crossmembers/cleats with CNC-located holes; fixed rear frame may stabilize but the service door is not the sole anchor

upper_backglass_carriage.bezel_interface: replaceable front bezel/filler frame independent from structural carrier

supports: smaller traditional-DMD aspect displays via replaceable bezel
non-VESA LCD panels using replaceable edge-clamp/tray adapter

speaker_baffle.rule: Changing the DMD or backglass display must not require rebuilding the speaker mounts.

structural_rear_frame.rear_frame_role: fixed perimeter/crossmember shear frame around the service aperture; service door is not relied upon as the sole shear diaphragm

rear_service_door.hinge: full-height stainless or zinc-plated piano/continuous hinge, or equivalent multi-hinge set
rear_service_door.preferred_lock: keyed cam/quarter-turn panel lock with adjustable tongue; two-point compression latch if door size/warpage testing requires it
rear_service_door.rule: The backbox remains closed during normal use. The rear door exists for keyed service access and must not create an unguarded opening when latched.

front_barriers.preferred_window: 3-4 mm tempered glass; clear polycarbonate acceptable where impact resistance is prioritized
front_barriers.speaker_openings: perforated metal/finger guard plus acoustic layer; add insect screen behind where airflow/acoustics permit

pest_and_dust_exclusion.note: Fine mesh and filters reduce airflow; intake/exhaust free area must be oversized and verified thermally.

electrical_touch_safety.display_mains_connection: fully insulated jacketed mains lead terminating in a touch-safe enclosed connector/receptacle; no open screw terminals
electrical_touch_safety.mains_splices_if_any: inside a separate tool-access-only certified/enclosed junction compartment that remains closed even when the keyed service door is open
electrical_touch_safety.metal_bonding: exposed conductive metal bonded to protective earth where required by final electrical architecture
electrical_touch_safety.vent_guarding: no direct finger/probe path to energized parts; external fan openings require rigid finger guards plus insect mesh/filter

reason: best visual use of the 780 mm future-proof backbox width
common low-cost size class with many 1080p/4K VESA options
larger image is more proportionate to the wide backbox
adjustable carrier and bezel still permit 27/28 inch fallback later
display_size_policy.27_inch_role: common smaller fallback if future 28 inch supply becomes poor
